arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Jeffrey Wall argued the Federal Circuit test is too rigid. He stated it immunizes bad faith copiers from any enhancement.
Jeffrey Martinez agreed mere negligence is not enough for enhanced damages. He argued the Federal Circuit wrongly bars damages for reasonable defenses.
Justice Breyer noted the statute allows courts to increase damages up to three times. He stated he does not get much guidance from that text.
